# MistralAI

## Docs

[API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/api-reference): Admin API reference: endpoint signatures, request/response schemas, and examples from OpenAPI spec
[Authentication](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/authentication): Admin API keys authenticate requests to Mistral's admin endpoints via the Backoffice
[Manage groups and roles](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/manage-groups-roles): Manage groups & roles via Admin API: create, assign, & provision users
[Manage users](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/manage-users): Manage users with the Admin API using `POST /v1/admin/users` and related endpoints
[Manage Workspaces](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/manage-workspaces): Manage Workspaces with the Admin API via `https://api.mistral.ai/v1/admin` using Admin API keys
[Overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/overview): Admin API overview: Enterprise-only tool for automating account management, provisioning users, and retrieving logs
[Usage metrics](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/usage-metrics): Admin API provides billing & product usage metrics via `/v1/admin` endpoints with an API key
[User provisioning](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/admin-api/user-provisioning): Provision users via Admin API: bulk create, group, grant access, update & remove from Workspace
[Billing](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/billing): Manage Mistral billing: payment methods, credits, spending limits, and invoices
[Invoices](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/invoices): View/download invoices via Admin Panel with Admin/Billing roles
[Subscriptions](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/subscriptions): Manage Mistral subscriptions, plans, and usage for your organization
[Usage and limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/usage-limits): Understand Mistral service usage, limits, and spending controls via Admin Panel dashboards and settings
[API key expiration policy](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/api-key-policy): API key expiration policy sets max validity days for new keys; existing keys unaffected
[API keys](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/api-keys): Manage API keys for Mistral API authentication and developer tools
[Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/connectors): Admin use Connectors in Admin to link shared apps, manage tools, and control access in Vibe & Studio
[Groups](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/groups): User groups simplify Workspace access by managing multiple users collectively via a single role assignment
[Roles and permissions (RBAC)](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/roles-permissions): Mistral uses RBAC with Organization & Workspace roles; permissions are additive and assigned via Admin Panel or API
[Service accounts](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/service-accounts): Service accounts enable non-human authentication for workloads, improving security and continuity
[User management](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/user-management): Manage Organization members, roles, and invitations via the Members page
[Workload identity federation](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/identity-access/workload-identity): Workload identity federation lets workloads authenticate as service accounts using short-lived, issuer-signed tokens, eliminating long-term credentials
[Overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/monitor-comply/audit-logs/overview): Audit logs track user & API activity chronologically for Enterprise plans
[Audit logs reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/monitor-comply/audit-logs/reference): Audit logs reference: fields, filters, actor/target types, and events with response fields like `created_at`, `actor_type`, and `event_type`
[Zero data retention](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/monitor-comply/zero-data-retention): Zero data retention (ZDR) disables API input/output storage for supported stateless calls on paid plans
[Admin overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/overview): Admin overview: Central control panel for managing organization access, usage, and automation in Mistral products
[Admin](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin): Admin: Set up orgs, configure SSO, manage API keys/users, and track billing across Workspaces
[Create your Organization](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/create-organization): Create and manage Organizations in Mistral with simple steps and details
[Enterprise Accounts and Backoffice](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/enterprise-accounts): Enterprise Accounts and Backoffice manage linked Organizations at an admin level above individual Organizations
[Email domain authentication](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/email-domain-authentication): Email domain authentication lets users with verified domains join your Organization via email matching
[SAML SSO](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/saml-sso): Configure SAML SSO for enterprise organizations to authenticate users via corporate identity providers
[Verify your domain](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/verify-domain): Verify your domain to enable enterprise features by adding and confirming DNS TXT records
[Workspace usage and limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/workspaces/usage-limits): Track and cap API/Vibe usage per Workspace to manage costs and budgets
[Workspaces in Studio](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/workspaces/workspaces-in-studio): Studio workspaces define context for API keys, resources, and usage; switching workspaces changes what users can see and do in Studio
[Workspaces in Vibe](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/workspaces/workspaces-in-vibe): Workspaces in Vibe define user context, scope, and access across conversations, projects, tools, and settings
[Your first Workspace](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/workspaces/your-first-workspace): Create and manage shared team environments with scoped resources, access, and usage limits
[Community](https://docs.mistral.ai/community): Discover Mistral AI's community channels, open-source projects, and developer programs
[Developers](https://docs.mistral.ai/developers): Integrate Mistral models into apps with API, SDKs, and resources
[SDK Clients](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/clients): Official SDK clients for Mistral AI's API in Python & TypeScript, plus third-party options
[Platform overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/platform-overview): Mistral AI offers three products: Vibe (unified agent for productivity & coding), Studio (developer console & API), and Admin (control plane for organizations)
[Configure SSO and domain verification](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/admin/configure-sso): Configure SSO and domain verification for Mistral Enterprise with DNS and IdP setup
[Create your organization](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/admin/create-organization): Create and set up a Mistral organization via Admin with billing and team access
[Manage workspaces and API keys](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/admin/manage-workspaces): Organize Mistral workspaces & API keys with spending controls in ~10 mins
[Build a workflow](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/developer/build-a-workflow): Build a workflow with Mistral's orchestration for resilient AI pipelines
[Build an agent with tools](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/developer/build-an-agent): Build Mistral agents with external tools via API calls in ~10 minutes
[Send your first API request](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/developer/first-api-request): Learn to send your first API request with Mistral's SDK in ~5 minutes
[Set up RAG with document search](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/developer/rag-document-search): Set up Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with document search using Mistral API
[Activate Studio and generate an API key](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/studio/activate-and-generate-api-key): Set up Mistral Studio & generate an API key in 5 minutes
[Create a reusable Prompt](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/studio/create-reusable-prompt): Create reusable Prompt templates in Studio for shared instructions, versioning, and easy testing
[Create a Skill in Studio](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/studio/create-skill): Create a Skill in Studio to package reusable methods or procedures for AI assistants
[Test a model in the API playground](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/studio/test-model-playground): Test Mistral models in Studio’s API playground with prompts, parameters & comparisons—no coding needed
[Install the Vibe CLI and send your first prompt](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/vibe-code/install-cli): Install the Vibe CLI, register your API key, and send your first prompt in under 5 minutes
[Scaffold a project with Vibe Code](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/vibe-code/scaffold-a-project): Scaffold projects from natural language using Vibe CLI with step-by-step previews and approvals
[Analyze a dataset](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/vibe-work/analyze-data): Analyze datasets in Work by uploading files and asking plain-language questions—no code needed (~10 min)
[Create your first Skill](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/vibe-work/create-first-skill): Create your first Skill in ~10 minutes: package repeatable methods into standardized, progressively disclosed Skills with `SKILL.md` files
[Run your first Vibe Work task](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/vibe-work/first-task): Learn to run your first Vibe Work task in ~5 minutes
[Amazon Bedrock](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/amazon_bedrock): Mistral AI models are available on Amazon Bedrock as managed serverless endpoints
[Azure AI](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/azure): Deploy Mistral AI models on Azure AI via pay-as-you-go APIs or quota-based GPU endpoints
[IBM watsonx.ai](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/ibm-watsonx): IBM watsonx.ai offers Mistral AI's Large model as a managed SaaS solution on IBM's platform
[Outscale](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/outscale): Mistral AI models are available on Outscale via managed deployments through their marketplace
[Cloud](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments): Mistral's models available on major cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake, IBM, and Outscale
[Snowflake Cortex](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/sfcortex): Mistral AI models like Mistral Large and 7B are available via Snowflake Cortex as serverless, managed endpoints
[Vertex AI](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/vertex): Deploy Mistral AI models on Google Cloud Vertex AI as fully managed, serverless endpoints
[Cerebrium](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/cerebrium): Cerebrium: Serverless AI infrastructure for deploying GPU-powered apps with low cold starts and pay-per-use pricing
[Cloudflare Workers AI](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/cloudflare): Deploy ML models on Cloudflare’s global network with Workers AI
[Self-Deployment](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment): Self-deploy Mistral AI models using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI for optimized inference
[SkyPilot](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/skypilot): SkyPilot: Deploy LLMs/AI jobs on any cloud with cost savings & managed execution
[TGI](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/tgi): TGI: High-performance toolkit for deploying and serving open-access LLMs via Docker with OpenAI-like API
[TensorRT](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/trt): Optimize & deploy LLMs with NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM and Triton backend
[vLLM](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/local-deployment/vllm): vLLM: Open-source LLM inference engine optimized for local Mistral model deployment
[Deployment](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment): Deploy Mistral models via cloud services or local infrastructure with open-weight or commercial options
[Labs](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/labs): Labs offer experimental models for testing and feedback, identified by the `labs-` prefix, but are not for production use
[Model lifecycle policy](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/model-lifecycle): Mistral models follow a lifecycle from Labs (experimental) to Retired, with stages for production readiness and silent updates
[Model Selection Guide](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/model-selection-guide): Selecting the best model for your data using key criteria and evaluation methods
[Inference](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference): Use Mistral models via API, compare options, route requests, and tune generation
[Priority Tier](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/priority-tier): Priority Tier offers priority API request queueing for enterprise workloads during high load
[Prompting](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/prompting): Mastering prompt crafting is key to maximizing Mistral models' response quality
[Regional inference](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/regional-inference): Regional inference routes Mistral API requests to geographically restricted GPU infrastructure for data compliance or lower latency
[Sampling](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/sampling): Adjust sampling parameters like Temperature, Top P, and penalties to control LLM output creativity and accuracy
[Products](https://docs.mistral.ai/products): Use Vibe for tasks & coding, Studio to build & deploy AI apps via Mistral API
[Fine-tuning API (legacy)](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/customization): Legacy guide for deprecated custom LLM model fine-tuning API
[Classifier Factory](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/finetuning/classifier_factory): Classifier Factory: deprecated tool for building classification models (moderation, intent detection, sentiment analysis)
[Fine-tuning](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/finetuning): Fine-tuning: Deprecated feature with $4 min fee & $2/month storage costs; prefer prompt engineering
[Text & Vision Fine-tuning](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/finetuning/text_vision_finetuning): Fine-tune Mistral models for text/vision tasks via AI Studio or API (deprecated)
[Mistral Moderation 2411](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/guardrailing/mistral_moderation_2411): `mistral-moderation-2411` deprecated; migrate to `mistral-moderation-2603` for updated policies
[Safe Prompt](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/guardrailing/safe_prompt): `safe_prompt` is deprecated; use Custom Guardrails for better moderation control
[Native reasoning (deprecated)](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/native-reasoning): Native reasoning models (`magistral-small/medium-latest`) are deprecated; use `mistral-small/medium-3-5` with `reasoning_effort` instead
[Error glossary](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/error-glossary): HTTP status codes, meanings, and resolutions for Mistral API errors
[Glossary](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/glossary): A glossary defining key terms in models, APIs, deployment, and platform features with links to relevant docs
[Known limitations](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations): Mistral platform limitations: context windows up to 256k tokens, rate limits by tier, and 400/429 errors for exceeding limits
[Supported languages](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/languages): Mistral's language models support strong performance in 30+ languages across European, Middle Eastern, South Asian, Southeast Asian, and East Asian regions
[MCP](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/mcp): Mistral MCP server connects AI agents to Studio workspaces via Model Context Protocol with API key authentication
[Migration guides](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/migration-guides): Migrate from OpenAI to Mistral API with simple client, URL, and model changes
[Observability integrations](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/observability-integrations): Monitor Mistral app observability with third-party integrations to track inputs, outputs, runtime, and quality signals
[Resources](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources): Mistral resources: SDKs, guides, glossary & support for building
[Release notes](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/release-notes): Release notes: Summary of updates and changes in the latest software version
[SDKs](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/sdks): Official SDK clients for Python & TypeScript to interact with Mistral AI's API
[Mistral AI Studio API files input filtering and access restriction](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-001): Mistral AI Studio API `/api/files` lacks input filtering, enabling unauthorized resource access; update to fix (CVSS 7.0)
[TanStack supply chain attack affecting Mistral SDK packages](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-002): TanStack supply chain attack impacted Mistral SDK packages; investigation closed, no infrastructure impact
[Security advisories](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories): Security advisories page lists Mistral AI vulnerabilities with actions and updates
[Code Interpreter](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/code_interpreter): Code Interpreter enables safe, on-demand code execution in isolated containers for tasks like data analysis and graphing
[Function Calling](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/function-calling): Function calling enables agents to use tools and workflows via built-in or custom functions

[Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/connectors): Connectors are MCP servers exposed as tools for AI models via API, with scoped access control
[Google](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/connectors/providers/google): Vibe by Mistral AI integrates Google services via OAuth 2.0 for secure AI-driven interactions
[Direct tool calling with Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/connectors/tool_calling): Directly call MCP tools on Connectors without model involvement for raw output or debugging
[Predicted outputs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/predicted-outputs): Predicted Outputs optimize response time by predefining predictable content, improving efficiency
[Prompt caching](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/prompt-caching): Prompt caching reduces costs & latency by reusing cached prompt prefixes via `prompt_cache_key`
[Chat completions](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/chat-completion): Generate text responses from prompts using LLMs via chat completion API
[Using prompts in chat completions](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/chat-completion/prompt-registry): Use prompts in chat completions by fetching stored prompts with the Prompt Registry for system messages, including template variables and version pinning
[Prompting](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/chat-completion/prompting): Mastering effective prompts is key to optimizing Mistral models' responses
[Citations & References](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/citations): Models can ground responses in sources via tool calls, providing citations & references for RAG & agentic apps
[Function Calling](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/function-calling): Mistral models use function calling to connect with external tools for specialized tasks like payment tracking
[Moderation & Guardrailing](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/moderation): Moderate LLM inputs/outputs with custom guardrails or Mistral's moderation API for safe deployment
[Reasoning](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/reasoning): Reasoning enhances Chain of Thought by training models to freely explore logical steps before final answers, improving problem-solving through extra computation
[Custom](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output/custom): Custom Structured Outputs ensure model responses strictly follow a predefined JSON schema for consistent formatting
[JSON Mode](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output/json_mode): Enable JSON mode by setting `response_format={"type": "json_object"}` for consistent JSON output
[Structured Outputs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output): Structured outputs in LLMs ensure formatted responses (JSON/custom) for reliable agent pipelines
[Vision](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/vision): Vision models analyze images alongside text for multimodal insights via the Chat Completions API
[Document Annotations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/annotations): Mistral Document AI API's Annotations feature extracts structured data from documents via customizable bbox and document annotations
[OCR Processor](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr): Extract text, tables, headers/footers from PDFs/images using Document AI OCR processor
[Document QnA](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna): Document AI QnA enables natural language interaction with documents using OCR and LLM for insights
[Document Processing](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/overview): Mistral Document AI provides enterprise OCR & structured data extraction with multilingual support and adaptable workflows
[Hidden Collection](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/hidden-collection): Test hidden collection visibility & direct URL access without sidebar/search/sitemap links
[Hidden collection setup](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/hidden-collection/setup): Hidden collection setup: verify direct URL access while keeping pages out of navigation
[Hidden collection troubleshooting](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/hidden-collection/troubleshooting): Hidden collection troubleshooting: resolve 404 errors & navigation issues with default-locale rewrites & hidden category filtering
[Hidden collection usage](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/hidden-collection/usage): Hidden child pages can include regular docs content while staying excluded from discovery surfaces
[Code Embeddings](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/knowledge-rag/embeddings/code_embeddings): Code embeddings enable retrieval, clustering, and AI-powered coding assistants via Mistral AI's API
[Embeddings](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/knowledge-rag/embeddings): Mistral's Embeddings API converts text/code into vector representations for semantic tasks like search, clustering, and classification
[Text Embeddings](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/knowledge-rag/embeddings/text_embeddings): Text embeddings convert text to numerical vectors for semantic search & NLP tasks
[RAG Quickstart](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/knowledge-rag/rag_quickstart): Build a RAG pipeline from scratch using retrieval and generation steps
[Use context objects](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/context-objects): Use context objects to pass inputs to tasks and scorers via typed Pydantic models
[Datasets](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/datasets): Datasets are lists of Python dicts defining test cases for offline evaluation in the Mistral SDK
[Set goals](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/goals): Set goals to define pass/fail criteria for evaluator scores in SDK output
[Judges](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/judges): Judges are LLM-based scorers for evaluations, useful for subjective criteria like helpfulness or tone
[Iterate locally](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/local-mode): Run evaluations locally with `local=True` for fast iteration before pushing results to Studio
[Combine evaluators](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/multiple-evaluators): Combine multiple evaluators in a single run, computing per-evaluator statistics automatically
[Reduce variance with multiple generations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/num-generations): Use `num_generations=N` to run tasks multiple times, aggregating mean/std for reliable non-deterministic results
[Offline evaluations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations): Offline evaluations via `mistralai-observability` SDK for LLM pipelines (Enterprise-only)
[Retry failed records](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/retry-failed-records): Retry failed records with SDK to patch results without rerunning entire evaluation
[Use run-level evaluators](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/run-evaluators): Run evaluators analyze full result sets for global metrics like F1 after all records are processed
[Configure system params](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/evaluations/system-params): Externalize task configurations in `System` to track pipeline settings for each LLM run via `ctx.system`
[Observability](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability): Observability provides AI app debugging via traces & offline evaluations for Enterprise-tier users
[Data redaction](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/traces/data-redaction): Spans are client-side redacted by default to remove secrets/PII before export
[Explore traces](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/traces/explorer): Explore and analyze AI application traces in Trace Explorer with detailed span data and performance metrics
[Distributed tracing](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/traces): Distributed tracing captures AI app requests as spans with inputs/outputs, latency, and token counts via OpenTelemetry
[Send traces](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/observability/traces/send-traces): Instrument Mistral SDKs, Workflows & Vibe tools to send OpenTelemetry traces with an API key
[Studio](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio): Mistral's Studio platform for building AI apps via API & console with model access & key management
[Moderation & Guardrailing](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/safety-moderation): Custom guardrails & moderation API for safe, controlled LLM deployments in production
[Agentic Search](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/agentic-search): Agentic Search enables agents to dynamically explore and analyze retrieved sources to gather evidence and answer complex queries beyond initial retrieval results
[Libraries](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/libraries): Persistent knowledge bases for agents with RAG via API document upload & access control
[Document model](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/concepts/document-model): Unified document model with `Document` and `DocumentChunk` linked by deterministic IDs for end-to-end search consistency
[Embedding model](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/concepts/embedding-model): `EmbeddingModel defines vector dimensions, data type, and distance metric for index tensors, aligning with embedder output.`
[Embedders](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/embedders): Embedders convert text into vector embeddings for semantic search
[Chunk enrichers](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/enrichers): Chunk enrichers add custom metadata to chunks during ingestion, like summaries or tags, to enhance retrieval and context
[Document extractors](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/extractors): Document extractors convert files into Documents with type-specific logic, stamping `file.source_id` for traceability
[File loaders](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/loaders): File loaders import files from sources (local/cloud) into `File` objects for processing
[Ingestion](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion): Ingestion transforms raw files into searchable chunks via pipeline components: load, extract, split, optionally enrich, embed, and index
[Text splitters](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/splitters): Text splitters divide documents into retrievable chunks, with choice impacting retrieval quality
[Search Toolkit](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit): Python framework for building IR systems with modular ingestion, retrieval, and evaluation components
[Quickstart](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/quickstart): Build a RAG pipeline in 5 minutes with Python 3.12+, Docker, and Mistral API
[Retrieval](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/retrieval): Retrieval pipeline combines search strategies, preprocessing, retrievers, and rerankers for optimal query results
[Query preprocessing](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/retrieval/preprocessing): Query preprocessing enhances retrieval by reformulating user queries using LLM rewriting, improving match quality at added latency/cost
[Rerankers](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/retrieval/rerankers): Rerankers refine initial search results using deeper models or logic for improved ranking quality
[Retrievers](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/retrieval/retrievers): Retrievers execute searches using vector, keyword, or hybrid methods to query your index
[Semantic cache](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/retrieval/semantic-cache): Semantic cache matches queries by meaning, returning cached results when similarity exceeds threshold, avoiding full retrieval
[Custom vector stores](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores): Implement custom vector stores by subclassing `VectorStoreIndex` and optionally `NavigableIndex` for agentic navigation
[Search index](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index): Storage backends for efficient search via vector stores like Vespa and Postgres
[Postgres](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres): Use PostgreSQL with pgvector/pg_textsearch as a Search Toolkit backend, supporting VectorStoreIndex, NavigableIndex, and PatchableIndex via separate plugin
[Anatomy of a Vespa application](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/anatomy): Vespa applications are built using migrations that define schemas, fields, and ranking for deployment
[CLI reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/cli): CLI tool for managing Vespa app lifecycle: migrations, deployment & testing
[Local development](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/local-development): Local development guide: schema creation, deployment, document management, and migrations with prerequisites and restrictions
[Migration helpers reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/migration-helpers): Reference for migration helpers in `mistralai.search.toolkit.plugins.vespa.migration`
[Manage schema](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/migrations): Manage Vespa application schemas using Python migrations under `vespa_app/migrations/`
[Deploy and operate](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/operations): Deploy and operate Vespa applications with connection settings, health checks, and production cluster guidelines
[Vespa](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa): Build, deploy, and manage Vespa applications with Python migrations and `mistral-vespa` CLI
[Manage ranking](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/query-profiles): Control ranking at query time using named query profiles with customizable weights and parameters
[Basics](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/activities/basics): Activity basics: defining, configuring, and structuring workflow units of work
[Local activities](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/activities/local_activities): Local activities run in-worker for fast ops (<1s) avoiding remote scheduling overhead
[Activities](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/activities): Activities: safe, isolated units of work with JSON-serializable I/O, automatic retries, and 2MB payload limits
[Sticky worker sessions](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/activities/sticky_worker_sessions): Sticky worker sessions route multiple activities to the same worker to reuse resources and maintain state, trading availability for efficiency
[Compression](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/compression): Enable compression for workflow inputs and activity I/O to reduce network usage and avoid payload offloading
[Connectors in workflows](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/connectors): Use Connectors in workflows to securely call external services without managing credentials yourself
[Consuming Streaming Events](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/consuming_events): Consume streaming workflow events via SDK client or raw HTTP SSE endpoints
[Continue-As-New](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/continue_as_new): Continue-As-New resets workflow history while preserving state for indefinitely long-running processes
[Dependency Injection](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/dependency_injection): Dependency Injection simplifies resource sharing by injecting providers into activities once at worker startup
[Durable agents](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/durable_agents): Durable agents are LLM agents running in workflows for state persistence, crashes, and tool integration via Mistral plugin
[Encryption](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/encryption): Encrypt all payloads before they leave your worker using AES-GCM encryption for secure storage and transmission
[Mistral client](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/mistral_client): `get_mistral_client()` provides a pre-configured Mistral SDK client with telemetry, observability, and authentication for workflows
[On-behalf-of workflows](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/on_behalf_of): On-behalf-of workflows enable user-identity actions with secure, short-lived credentials in hardened deployments
[Payload offloading](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/payload_offloading): Mistral Workflows enforces 2MB limits; use offloading helpers to pass large data via references
[Plugins](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/plugins): Mistral Workflows plugins are reusable Python packages for workflows, activities, and dependencies under `mistralai.workflows.plugins`
[Workflow scheduling](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/scheduling): Workflow scheduling runs recurring workflows via cron/interval, persisting across restarts
[Streaming Events](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/streaming): Stream events in real-time from workflows using Task context manager for live UIs and LLM responses
[Child workflows](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/sub_workflows): Child workflows enable hierarchical orchestration with independent durable histories, while activities handle single side-effect tasks
[Waiting for Conditions](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/waiting_for_conditions): Workflows pause execution until a condition is met via external signals, enabling event-driven patterns
[Workflows Exception](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/building-workflows/workflow_exception): Structured `WorkflowsException` for expected errors; propagate unexpected ones

[Concurrency Patterns](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/concurrency): Scale Mistral Workflows efficiently with parallel execution patterns for large datasets
[Deployments](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/deployments): Deployments manage worker groups for workflow execution with required DEPLOYMENT_NAME for isolation and routing in shared workspaces
[API Error Codes](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/error_codes): API error codes reference for Workflows API with structured `WF_XXXX` format and HTTP status categories
[Execution Context](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/execution_context): Access runtime info about current workflow execution, including execution ID
[Hardened deployments](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/hardened_deployments): Hardened deployments restrict workflow registration to predefined API keys or service accounts, enabling secure credential rotation
[Rate Limiting](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/rate_limiting): Rate limiting controls resource usage in workflows by sharing limits across workers, either per activity or via shared keys
[Resetting Workflows](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/managing-workflows-in-production/reset_workflow): Reset a workflow execution to restart from a specific point after fixing underlying issues
[Observability](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/observability): Workers export OpenTelemetry telemetry (logs, traces, metrics) to Mistral by default for observability in Studio
[Workflow Tags](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio-api/workflows/building-workflows/workflow_tags): Workflow tags enable searchable metadata for workflows, supporting filtering, discovery, and management via API/UI
[Agents](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/chat-legacy/agents): Agents are legacy Chat features for reusable assistants; use Skills in Vibe Work instead
[Code Interpreter](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/chat-legacy/code-interpreter): Code Interpreter in Vibe runs Python securely for data tasks; legacy Chat feature with no deprecation date
[Deep Research](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/chat-legacy/deep-research): Deep Research automates multi-step web research in Vibe, reducing hours to minutes with structured reports and citations
[Memories](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/chat-legacy/memories): Vibe's Memories feature retains your preferences & context to personalize future chats
[Think mode](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/chat-legacy/think-mode): Think mode in Vibe uses Magistral models for step-by-step reasoning in Chat, available as a legacy feature
[Choose Chat, Work, or Code](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/choose-chat-work-code): Choose Work mode for multi-step tasks, tool integrations, and agent-driven actions in Vibe
[Choose CLI, VS Code, or web sessions](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/choose-cli-vscode-web-sessions): Choose CLI, VS Code, or web sessions for Vibe Code's flexible agent surfaces
[Admin config](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/admin-config): Admin config distributes Vibe Code CLI settings to users via Admin Panel, not for security
[Agents](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/agents): Agents are configuration overrides with system prompts, models, tools, and approval rules; CLI includes built-in agents like `default`, `plan`, `auto-approve`, etc
[API keys and profiles](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/api-keys-profiles): Manage Mistral API keys and credentials for Vibe Code CLI usage
[Commands and shortcuts](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/commands-shortcuts): Use slash commands & keyboard shortcuts to control Vibe sessions directly in the terminal
[Configuration](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/configuration): Vibe Code CLI configures via `config.toml` (project/user-level, project overrides), editable via editor or `/config` command
[Configuration reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/configuration-reference): Concise config.toml reference: all keys, grouped by section, with defaults and descriptions
[Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/connectors): Connectors provide Mistral-managed integrations for Vibe Code CLI to access third-party services, unlike self-configured MCP servers
[Hooks](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/hooks): Hooks in Vibe Code CLI enable lifecycle command integration for gating, auditing, or modifying agent behavior via `hooks.toml`
[Install and setup](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/install-setup): Install and set up the Vibe CLI with the one-line installer or manually via `uv`/`pip`
[MCP servers](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/mcp-servers): MCP servers extend Vibe Code CLI via Model Context Protocol, configured in `config.toml` for external tools
[Using offline models](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/offline-models): Use Vibe Code CLI with any OpenAI-compatible offline model like Devstral Small 2 or Mistral Small 4 for local inference
[Skills](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/skills): Skills are reusable instruction sets extending Vibe Code via YAML-defined directories with portable, tool-restricted workflows
[Teleport from CLI to web](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/teleport-cli-web): Teleport CLI sessions to Vibe Code Web sandbox for remote access & cloud execution
[Work with the CLI](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/work-with-cli): Use the CLI in interactive or programmatic mode for chat, scripting, and CI tasks
[Vibe Code](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/overview): Vibe Code automates coding tasks with filesystem access, shell commands, and PR creation, all under your supervision
[Safety, approvals, and permissions](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/safety-approvals-permissions): Vibe Code uses layered controls (agents, trusted folders, per-tool permissions) to safely manage file access, code edits, and shell commands on your behalf
[Use Vibe in other IDEs](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/use-vibe-in-other-ides): Use Vibe in ACP-compatible IDEs like JetBrains via the Agent Client Protocol registry
[Get started](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/get-started): Vibe Code Web: cloud control plane for remote coding agents, creating branches/PRs directly from your browser
[GitHub repositories](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/github-repositories-permissions): GitHub repositories & permissions with Mistral GitHub App authentication explained
[Limits and lifecycle](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/limits-and-lifecycle): Vibe Code Web sessions run in isolated sandboxes, with defined lifecycle phases, limits, and automatic cleanup
[Projects](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/projects): Create, manage, and delete projects in Vibe Code Web for GitHub repositories
[Sandbox environment](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/sandbox-environment): Isolated cloud sandbox per Vibe Code Web session with default Linux image and no persistence after session ends
[Security](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/security): Autonomous agent security model in Vibe Code Web: handling untrusted content & session data retention
[Sessions](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/sessions): Sessions are Vibe Code agent runs with sandbox, agent loop, and resulting branch/PR, starting via web, CLI, or teleport
[Vibe Code Web for Slack: Quickstart](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vibe-code-web/slack-integration): Set up AI-powered coding sessions in Slack with Vibe Code Web
[Agents](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/agents): Agents are configuration overrides with system prompts, models, tools, and approval rules; VS Code extension includes a `Chat` mode
[Commands and slash commands](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/commands-slash-commands): Vibe Code slash commands & keyboard shortcuts for editor control
[Install and authenticate](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/install-authenticate): Install Mistral Vibe for VS Code, open the Vibe panel, and sign in
[Migration from Mistral Code Enterprise](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/migration-mistral-code-enterprise): Migrate from Mistral Code to Mistral Vibe by installing Vibe, authenticating, and optionally uninstalling Mistral Code—no automatic settings transfer
[Extension settings](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/settings): VS Code extension uses Vibe CLI config for behavior & telemetry; opt-out via VS Code or `~/.vibe/config.toml`
[Work with the extension](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/vs-code-extension/work-with-extension): Use VS Code extension for seamless Vibe Code integration with files, selections, and source control
[Vibe](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe): Vibe is Mistral’s unified agent for productivity & coding, now replacing Le Chat with Work, Code & legacy Chat modes
[MCP Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/connectors/mcp-connectors): Connect Work to any MCP-compatible service via pre-configured connectors or custom servers
[Connect tools with Connectors](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/connectors): Connect tools securely to external apps via Connectors for seamless data access & actions in Work
[Set custom instructions](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/custom-instructions): Set custom instructions to define persistent preferences for Work's responses
[Work with Files and Canvas](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/files-and-canvas): Work with Files & Canvas to upload, edit, and refine deliverables directly in chat
[Get started with Work](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/get-started): Start tasks in Work by describing outcomes in natural language for AI-driven multi-step execution
[Generate images](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/image-generation): Generate and edit images in chat using plain language with Black Forest Labs models
[Add context with Libraries](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/libraries): Libraries provide persistent, real-time knowledge bases from your documents for cross-session task use
[Group tasks with Projects](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/projects): Group tasks into Projects for focused chats with shared context, tone, and files
[Safety and approvals](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/safety-and-approvals): Work ensures safety by requiring approval for all sensitive external actions
[Schedule tasks](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/scheduled-tasks): Schedule tasks to run prompts automatically at future or recurring times with Work capabilities
[Reuse work with Skills](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/skills): Skills are reusable instructions that give Work specialized capabilities for specific tasks
[Switch Organization or Workspace](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/switch-organization-workspace): Switch between Organizations and Workspaces via the sidebar in the Vibe app
[Use Voice mode](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/voice-mode): Use Voice mode to dictate prompts via speech in Work on web/mobile apps
[Search the web](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/web-search-open-url): Work can browse the internet in real time using web search or Open URL for up-to-date, sourced information
[Run Workflows](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/work/workflows): Run Workflows directly in chat via the `+` menu, no CLI or API needed
